svg.title: Type II — six-axis stiffness profile
svg.desc: Type II illustrative six-axis stiffness profile traced from the raster image of manuscript Figure 2B. The common coordinate frame and relative geometry are retained. These are digitized figure coordinates, not raw stiffness measurements. Rotational scaling: k*ri = 5 kri / R².
svg.metadata: {"source": "Manuscript Figure 2B, Modeling.jpg", "method": "Color-separated contour centerlines fitted to the original raster; illustrative tracing only.", "pixel_coordinates": [[434.34, 317.68], [372.7, 338.27], [244.14, 519.58], [198.41, 318.46], [300.98, 213.89], [479.09, 113.64]], "coordinate_units": "source-image pixels, not stiffness units", "uncertainty_pixels": "typically \u00b12\u20133; blue right tip approximately \u00b16", "shared_frame": [[618, 318], [489, 540], [233, 540], [104, 318], [233, 96], [489, 96]]}
